item.title: Polyglot Unconference 2026 Recap
item.description:
I attended the Polyglot Software Unconference in Vancouver on Saturday, October 17, 2026. This was my second time attending. I posted my recap of the first one a year late, so this time I’m trying to make it right by posting my recap sooner.

Late arrival

I’m kind of embarrassed to admit that I arrived late. But I have a good excuse: the night before, my husband and I went fishing at this beautiful lake. We didn’t catch anything, but it was still worthwhile. We got back home really late, at around 10 pm, so in the morning I overslept.

item.title: Travel Budgeting without Spreadsheet
item.description:
This is a follow up to my previous post, Travel Planning with AI.

One of my parting thoughts in that post is about travel budgeting and spreadsheets. Having a budget is important part of our travel decision-making. It helps us decide whether we could even afford the trip, or maybe we need to cut down on the number of travel days, things like that. The budget is also important to be tracked during the trip, to ensure we remain close to the budget and not overspend.

item.title: Travel Planning with AI
item.description:
Travel Planning with AI

I have started planning my family’s travel with the assistance of Claude Code. It resulted in a website that contains information about our travel destination, potential activities we could take, hotel recommendations, restaurant suggestions, and even a checklist with timelines for me to keep track of the planning progress, all the information needed in order to plan and decide about our family vacation.
